actions: Inspect the breather hose and connection
Remove the breather hose only if replacing it
canonicalStep.title: valve-cover-breather-hose-location (BMW 328i draft PCV / Crankcase Ventilation — Inspection & Diagnosis guide; evidence step 4, 5, 6)

elements.describe: The plastic cylinder head cover with the integrated crankcase vent and oil separator (one part), with an oil filler cap on top and a row of six ignition coils.
The push-on breather hose connection at the back of the valve cover.
Two side tabs on the hose end that are squeezed to release it; the hose must not be pried.
The oil filler cap on the valve cover.
Six ignition coils standing in the cover, one per cylinder.
Unestablished detail of valve cover: No standalone PCV valve, separate oil separator box, rubber diaphragm or external heated valve: none exist on this design.
Unestablished detail of oil filler cap: Position on the cover is not established.
Unestablished detail of breather hose release tabs: Tab outline and colour are not described.
